facts.fact: Gazette 记者 Madalena 坐在 Marcelle 家前门外矮墙上等着，开口就对 Jourdain 说听说你被控谋杀
facts.anchor: I hear you’ve been accused of murder.

facts.fact: Madalena 起身时暴露 serrage：不是重症，但明确无误；她自称多年写医护政治与 Hospital
facts.anchor: Serrage: not a severe case, but unmistakable.

facts.fact: Jourdain 威胁写信给她的编辑和 Lord Baizelat，要求把她从 Gazette 撤掉
facts.anchor: writing to your editor and Lord Baizelat to ask that you be removed

facts.fact: Estiene 问父亲是否想多知道今天到底发生了什么，Jourdain 答不太想
Estiene 在心里承认对父亲的信任到此为止，并自问父亲是否真可能一开始就让人杀 Ysabel
facts.anchor: Would I put it entirely past you to have Ysabel killed in the first place?

facts.fact: Estiene 当面质问父亲：为让他拿高分，父亲与 Chancellor 做了交易
facts.anchor: you had to make a deal with the Chancellor to cheat my way into a high grade

facts.fact: 父亲送他出门时下令：不许对任何记者或他人谈，低头把试考过，日后再处理 Thoury 与 gendarmerie
facts.anchor: Keep your head down and pass your exam and we’ll deal with Augustin Thoury

facts.fact: Estiene 推断便条为何寄给他而非 Clement/Moyna：别人被栽赃他还能与 Alys 一起动用家族资源，而他父亲已被削掉威慑力
facts.anchor: Estiene’s father had been effectively defanged.
